form.label: Brief — App detail
form.description: Per-app drill-down: subscores, proposed descriptions, and safety findings from the most recent audit run.

search.query: index=brief_scores status=ok earliest=-30d | stats latest(_time) as _time by app_name | sort -_time
index=brief_scores status=ok app_name="$app_name$" earliest=-30d | stats latest(overall_score) as score
index=brief_scores status=ok app_name="$app_name$" earliest=-30d | stats latest(presence_pct) as v
index=brief_scores status=ok app_name="$app_name$" earliest=-30d | stats latest(quality_avg) as v
index=brief_scores status=ok app_name="$app_name$" earliest=-30d | stats latest(safety_pct) as v
index=brief_scores status=ok app_name="$app_name$" earliest=-90d | timechart span=1d avg(overall_score) as "Score"

index=brief_scores status=ok app_name="$app_name$" earliest=-30d | stats latest(proposed_count) as Proposed, latest(rubric_count) as "Rubric scores", latest(described_count) as Described, latest(total_objects) as "Total objects" by _time | sort -_time | head 5 | rename _time as "Last audit"
